en.topic_title: Hong Kong fertility clinic probed after sending wrong embryo samples for DNA testing
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong authorities are investigating a human reproductive medical centre after it allegedly sent the wrong embryo specimens from two couples for DNA testing, the city’s health minister has said.



Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau told the press on Wednesday that the authorities had reported the incidents at Heal Fertility Centre to the police.
